paper.title: SEDM: Selective Self-Evolving Distributed Memory for Agents
paper.central_claim: SEDM用执行对照决定共享memory保留与当前使用，CMG利用ties与校准在降低输入成本时保留或恢复memory收益。

provenance.notes: 配置声明agent_model=sonnet / actual_model=gpt-6.1-sol；无独立后端模型回执及会话标识，按模板置null；未探测模型。

sections_read: Appendix A–I including Tables6–9, Figure4 caption

evidence.quote: Ties are 78% of our HotpotQA training pairs and most of our LoCoMo pairs, yet still carry information about success under both actions.
evidence.support_explanation: 赢家标签丢掉大多数paired outcomes，双头BCE保留难度信息。

evidence.quote: An SCEC stores the task input, the agent output, summaries of tool calls, random seeds, and hashes of the configuration.
evidence.support_explanation: 固定任务/配置/种子及工具摘要；不等于完整外部环境复现。

evidence.quote: is the source task itself, whose SCEC is replayed with and without
evidence.support_explanation: 原版准入测试源任务，不能当独立holdout。

evidence.quote: In the held-out configuration, two filters run before the test: a candidate is dropped if its source task was not solved, and if it contains the reference answer of a task it is tested on, since it would then pass only by leaking the answer.
evidence.support_explanation: 新配置有成功源与答案泄漏过滤。

evidence.quote: merges near-duplicate items from different SCECs, distills repeated patterns into new
evidence.support_explanation: 库合并/蒸馏/隔离/衰减为显式步骤，非只改变检索器。

evidence.quote: a rule-based abstraction replaces specific entities with typed placeholders and produces a general form,
evidence.support_explanation: 跨域抽象为规则式去实体；不是LLM独立创制通用理论。

evidence.quote: they need not sum to one, because both actions can succeed or both can fail.
evidence.support_explanation: 两独立成功概率可编码00与11，不是互斥winner softmax。

evidence.quote: After training, we fit one temperature per action on a separate calibration split by minimizing NLL
evidence.support_explanation: 校准与训练/测试角色分离。

evidence.quote: several of which are taken from prior work
evidence.support_explanation: LoCoMo旧基线未全重跑，memory budgets可能不同。

evidence.quote: On HotpotQA, admission alone (37) is still below G-Memory (38); self-scheduling then adds 2 points on both tasks with only a small increase in prompt tokens
evidence.support_explanation: 累加消融非每项总是提升；存在负结果。

evidence.quote: All runs use cross-domain diffusion, so these results show that SEDM memories transfer, but they do not isolate how much of the transfer is due to abstraction.
evidence.support_explanation: 迁移有结果而抽象的因果贡献未隔离。

evidence.quote: test split, 489 questions, seed 42
evidence.support_explanation: 主表n=489一个seed，其他种子附录。

evidence.quote: CMG reaches 0.329, within the confidence interval of always use, while injecting memory on 69% of the tasks and using 18% fewer agent input tokens.
evidence.support_explanation: 0.329 vs0.333接近而不是更高成功率，18%节省仅agent input。

evidence.quote: SEDM builds candidate memories from conversation 0 and admits them with held-out paired tests on conversation 1
evidence.support_explanation: 独立来源/准入；测试另conversation2。

evidence.quote: Single differences on 193 questions are within the noise of one conversation, but the direction holds for all three seeds, both memories, and both metrics.
evidence.support_explanation: LoCoMo小差异不显著，方向跨seed非跨conversation。

evidence.quote: the memory comes from a single conversation and is frozen, so merged and distilled items become more general but may not fit a new conversation, and the controller cannot correct their weights during testing.
evidence.support_explanation: 准入/调度不保证转移；controller memory总注入反降。

evidence.quote: We did not rerun them under the stricter held-out configuration
evidence.support_explanation: 旧主表没有严格准入重跑，范围限定必要。

evidence.quote: We do not study a gate that keeps learning while the society memory keeps changing.
evidence.support_explanation: 不支持open-ended持续协同演化或improver进步。

evidence.quote: evidence memories use the gold supporting sentences of the memory-construction questions.
evidence.support_explanation: Hotpot memory是过去任务被金标准验证后的乐观构造，不是test泄漏。

evidence.quote: The CoT gate is a zero-shot reproduction with the same backbone, not the original trained checkpoint.
evidence.support_explanation: 强弱比较受到训练配置差异限制。

evidence.quote: Questions are split into five disjoint sets: memory construction (2,962), gate training (2,962), validation (496), calibration (496), and test (489).
evidence.support_explanation: 冻结五分区角色明确，测试只最终用一次。

evidence.quote: this is the only difference between the two runs.
evidence.support_explanation: memory on/off同执行器与工具环境，控制CMG因果。

evidence.quote: 95% bootstrap confidence intervals (2,000 resamples over questions;
evidence.support_explanation: 测试bootstrap但非所有系统/流种子方差与显著性。

evidence.quote: CMG is trained with three seeds (42, 43, 44); other gates use seed 42.
evidence.support_explanation: 三训练种子有范围，比较基线非都重复。

evidence.quote: a question counts as solved if the SBERT similarity between the answer and the reference is at least 0.7; we also report token F1.
evidence.support_explanation: SBERT语义阈值可能接受错误关系/实体；辅以F1，无人工审计。

evidence.quote: Collecting all paired runs used about 24.7M input and 1.3M output tokens of gpt-4o-mini (about US$4.5).
evidence.support_explanation: 有paired rollout采集成本；非全系统建库、准入、训练和GPU成本。

evidence.quote: Earlier versions of our pipeline executed such answers, so tool results were partly imagined.
evidence.support_explanation: 已知虚构Observation修复：stop at Observation并仅执行first action；旧表的独立重跑受限。

evidence.quote: Code for data preparation, paired collection, gate training, calibration, and evaluation will be released.
evidence.support_explanation: 仅承诺将发布代码，不虚称代码复现。

evidence.quote: CMG injects this memory on only 33% of the questions, saves 31% of the tokens
evidence.support_explanation: controller-managed冻结库门控可将总注入负收益转为小正收益。

evidence.quote: so that items that do not hurt the admission tasks are also kept.
evidence.support_explanation: e=3/k=3/eta=0保留ties；不是统计保证不退化。

signatures.information: 源任务输入、输出、工具摘要、种子、hash
signatures.operation: paired memory-on/off replay→按平均reward delta准入→tier/merge/distill/isolate/decay
signatures.conditions: 相似准入题的边际效用可转移；判分可信
signatures.selection_rule: 原版源任务；新配置e=3、每arm k=3、eta=0和两前置过滤
signatures.persistence: admitted外部条目、权重、tier；reject audit record不可检索
signatures.later_use: 新问题先相似检索并utility重排
signatures.claimed_effect: 旧表FEVER62→66/Hotpot38→39；严格冻结库总注入可反降
signatures.failure_boundary: source selection bias、合并漂移、no硬size bound、持续society未验证

signatures.operation: Qwen3-4B LoRA双头BCE全部paired含ties→独立温度校准→gain>lambda*length才use
signatures.output: 每个后续任务的USE/SKIP，未改memory内容
signatures.conditions: 训练分布与memory稳定；预测增益在校准后可比较
signatures.feedback: 训练/校准由两个action的执行成功标签
signatures.persistence: 训练gate参数+固定外部memory，评价期间冻结
signatures.later_use: 当前新任务单次gate后多步agent
signatures.failure_boundary: gate不学习写入；无证据证明改进程序自身越来越强；新memory分布失配

gap.author_gap: 相关/源任务有用不意味着当前memory增益；winner-only丢多数ties；LLM CoT门昂贵
gap.checked_gap: 本文测到memory-on害对和大量ties，校准双action成功率比相似性代理更贴当前gain；原准入source leakage修正与旧结果分开

Hotpot F1>=0.5、LoCoMo SBERT>=0.7并给tokenF1；无人工/实体关系错答审计

claims.text: SEDM准入、调度、diffusion使共享memory更好/便宜
claims.selection_vs_test: 旧版候选测试源SCEC；新版strict只§4.6，不能混写
claims.result/denominator: LoCoMo open F1 47.5 vs32.4；FEVER66 vs62/Hotpot39 vs38，input少32%/16%（Table1–2）；其他LoCoMo类型不是最优
counterevidence: source-task准入可能过估；旧LoCoMo有引自其他论文的不等budget基线；diffusion未ablate
claims.allowed_conclusion: 作者旧配置上任务结果；不证明严格heldout持续society总体占优

claims.text: CMG保留helpful memory收益、降低输入开销
claims.setting: controlled HotpotQA n489；固定gold-verified episode库及7step ReAct
counterevidence: .329与.333区间重叠不是显著优效/非劣效证明
CoT未使用原trained checkpoint；GPU latency shared load
claims.allowed_conclusion: 特定冻结库下接近always-use成功率的input节省；不是全成本节省18%

claims.text: 全SEDM内门控可从有害memory恢复价值
claims.setting: LoCoMo conv0造库/1准入/3–7训gate/8val/9cal/2test n193，3gate seeds
claims.baseline/control: 两套分别冻结memory内部各自同paired runs：always/never/CMG；两个memory不可直接比
claims.selection_vs_test: test conversation与构造/准入/训练/校准disjoint，gate及memory测试时不更新
claims.result/denominator: admission only skip .544/use .539/CMG .556±.011, input -19%；controller skip .534/use .518/CMG .546, input -31%
counterevidence: 单conversation统计小差值；合并后泛化可能损害；无持续演化
claims.allowed_conclusion: 冻结非权重memory跨conversation后，recipient门控有条件收益；不支持开放society/improver越来越强

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 冻结shared non-weight memory由别的任务/对话构造与准入，后续不同任务可读取；CMG同库paired对照显示输入节省及条件性更好成功率。不是improver或开放持续society结果。
unresolved: 严格协议下旧主表重跑
跨conversation/agent重复、显著性与判分审计
完整训练+准入+维护成本

G.reason: 将relevance/过去utility与当前增益分开，并具体指出ties监督损失；与retrieval/calibration谱系有本文来源，缺独立最近邻原文。

M.reason: paired所有四种outcome、双独立头、单次编码、独立temperature及成本阈值可完整重建并预测winner-only/随机门差异；sender admission与recipient use角色清楚。

X.reason: 权重初始化/周期合并/隔离/衰减与冻结测试、split权限及gate训练接口详细；merge/distill细则和部分阈值仍不完备，无硬size cap/持续变库部署。

E.measurement.reason: 公开任务EM/F1、统一工具执行规则和独立paired结果明确；新版修复虚构Observation。LoCoMo SBERT>=.7及Hotpot宽松F1>=.5缺错误/人工审计，F1旁证可用但不足4。

E.causality.reason: CMG同库同cached executions、always/never/random及winner/calibration对照有力；sender只有旧配置累加消融、diffusion未拆，CoT baseline零样本且训练不等。

E.holdout.reason: 新配置LoCoMo按conversation五角色、Hotpot五disjoint split并使用heldout calibration，有跨题留存；原表在源任务准入未strict重跑，单test conversation且memory frozen，不推open-ended。

E.statistics.reason: 有489/193分母、2000bootstrap置信区间、3 gate seeds及SD/全lambda曲线；无跨memory/测试conversation重复与显著性检验。A2 3+条件未齐，非从CI重叠声称非劣效。

E.cost.reason: 测量agent input并给gate延迟和paired collection 24.7M+1.3M/$4.5；无全memory构造/多次准入/维护和LoRA训练GPU成本，shared latency也非稳定端到端。

reason: 固定全文含A–I附录完整；外部memory通过paired准入并供独立任务使用，严格与旧源任务配置及训练gate范围分开。
rationale: 准入和接收方门控目标清楚；双头利用ties、独立校准与同运行对照支持条件性降输入成本。严格测试仅单对话、库冻结，不能外推持续society或全成本节省。
